description: The field shell's main window only, and only the two token commands, allowed by name. No core plugin grant, no filesystem, no shell, and none of the device grants today: they land with the field's own apps, in this file and nowhere else. The barcode scanner needs no Tauri grant: it asks for the camera through the webview's own web API. The OS usage description for that ask is prepared beside the conf (Info.plist), but this profile is not packaged yet (bundle.active false), so nothing merges the file into an app today; until the packaging lands, the hand proof on a device is the only proof of the camera. Once sign in writes it, the core's keychain store keeps the refresh token in the OS keychain and hands only the access token to the app's own origins.
